src.title: HIGH PROTEIN Korean Chicken Rice | MEAL PREP

recipes.title: Korean Gochujang Chicken Rice Bowls with Cucumber Salad

items.i: ground white pepper and cooking spray
spring onion, thinly sliced (white for the salad, green to garnish)

steps: Mix the sliced cucumber with the gochujang, 2 grated garlic cloves, soy sauce, rice wine vinegar, gochugaru, sesame oil, the sliced spring onion whites, a little salt and white pepper. Refrigerate.
Mix the chicken with the soy sauce, gochujang, sriracha, sesame oil, the remaining garlic, the ginger and white pepper. Use straight away or marinate up to 48 hours.
Spread the chicken and all the marinade on a lined, lightly oiled tray and bake at 200°C / 390°F for 20–22 minutes (or air fry), until cooked and caramelised. Rest 5 minutes, then dice.
Bring the rice, water and a pinch of salt to a boil, then cover and cook on low for 12 minutes. Leave covered off the heat for 4 minutes, then fluff with the sesame seeds.

Divide the rice, chicken (with the pan juices) and cucumber salad between 5 containers and garnish with spring onion greens and sesame seeds. Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 4 months frozen (store the cucumbers separately if freezing).
